Joining the military is a great option for recent high school graduates. We’re in peacetime. Hardly any troops are in a combat zone these days. For four years, you get free housing, free healthcare, pretty much free food, etc. You’ll meet and serve with young men and women that you’ll become lifelong friends with. Then once your short four years is up the possibilities are endless. If you’re smart you’ll easily be able to save a ton of money. I know someone who has 30k just sitting in a savings account. Or you can invest your money in the military’s TSP program. Which is pretty much a government Roth 401k account for federal employees and military. Then once you’re out you can use your GI Bill to go to almost any college in the world. And they even pay for a housing allowance too. I have a friend who decided to go to school in Japan.
